JJK-3-001.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-001.effectJp: 【エナジーLにある場合】自分と相手のアタックフェイズ終了時、自分のフロントLに〈五条 悟〉と〈夏油 傑〉がどちらもない場合、このキャラをフロントLに移動させる。【起動メイン】【エナジーLにある場合】【レストにする】【手札を1枚場外に置く】【ターン1】必要エナジーが5以下の自分の場の〔〈五条 悟〉か〈夏油 傑〉〕を1枚選び、アクティブにする。
JJK-3-001.effectEn: [While in Energy Line] At the end of both players' Attack Phases, if you have neither <Satoru Gojo> nor <Suguru Geto> in your Front Line, move this character to the Front Line. [Activate: Main] [While in Energy Line] [Rest this card] [Put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area] [Once Per Turn] Choose 1 <Satoru Gojo> or <Suguru Geto> on your field with required energy 5 or less, set it to active.

JJK-3-002.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-002.effectJp: 【登場時】カードを1枚引き、自分の手札を1枚場外に置く。
JJK-3-002.effectEn: [On Play] Draw 1 card(s), then put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.

JJK-3-003.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-003.effectJp: 【アタック時】自分の山札の上から1枚見る。そのカードを自分の山札の上か下に置く。
JJK-3-003.effectEn: [When Attacking] Look at the top 1 card(s) of your deck. Put that card on the top or bottom of your deck.

JJK-3-004.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-004.effectJp: 【登場時】自分の山札の上から5枚見る。その中から〈天内 理子〉か〈沖縄旅行〉を1枚まで公開し手札に加える。残りを望む順で自分の山札の下に置く。手札に加えた場合、自分の手札を1枚場外に置く。
JJK-3-004.effectEn: [On Play] Look at the top 5 card(s) of your deck. Reveal up to 1 <Riko Amanai> or <Okinawa Trip> among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you added it to your hand, put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.
JJK-3-004.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-004.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-005.effectJp: 【自分のターン中】【フロントLにある場合】同じラインに〈五条 悟〉があるか、自分の場か場外に〈天内 理子〉がある場合、このキャラはBP+1000。【登場時】APを1支払ってもよい。そうした場合、自分の場外から必要エナジーが3以下で消費APが1の特徴に「呪霊」を持つ黄のキャラカードを1枚まで自分の場にレストで登場させる。
JJK-3-005.effectEn: [During Your Turn] [While in Front Line] If <Satoru Gojo> is in the same line, or <Riko Amanai> is on your field or in your Outside Area, this character gets BP+1000. [On Play] You may pay 1 AP. If you do, play up to 1 Yellow character card(s) with the trait “Cursed Spirit”, required energy 3 or less and AP cost 1 from your Outside Area to your field rested.

JJK-3-006.effectJp: 【自分のターン中】【フロントLにある場合】同じラインに〈夏油 傑〉があるか、自分の場か場外に〈天内 理子〉がある場合、このキャラはBP+1000と【インパクト（1）】を得る。【登場時】自分の山札の上から3枚見る。その中から〈術式順転「蒼」〉か〈術式反転「赫」〉か〈虚式「茈」〉を1枚まで公開し手札に加える。残りを望む順で自分の山札の下に置く。手札に加えた場合、自分の手札を1枚場外に置く。
JJK-3-006.effectEn: [During Your Turn] [While in Front Line] If <Suguru Geto> is in the same line, or <Riko Amanai> is on your field or in your Outside Area, this character gets BP+1000 and gains [Impact 1]. [On Play] Look at the top 3 card(s) of your deck. Reveal up to 1 <Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue> or <術式反転「赫」> or <虚式「茈」> among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you added it to your hand, put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.

JJK-3-007.effectJp: 【ターン1】自分の場の〈嵌合暗翳庭〉の【起動メイン】が発動した時、自分の場の〈伏黒 恵〉全ては、このターン中、BP+1000。【登場時】自分の場の［特徴：式神］と〈嵌合暗翳庭〉の合計枚数×1000以下のBPの相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚まで選び、退場させる。
JJK-3-007.effectEn: [Once Per Turn] When [Activate: Main] of <嵌合暗翳庭> on your field activates, all <Megumi Fushiguro> on your field get BP+1000 this turn. [On Play] Choose up to 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP equal to or less than 1000 × the total number of [Trait: Shikigami] and <嵌合暗翳庭> on your field, and retire it.

JJK-3-008.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-008.effectJp: このキャラが自分の場から手札に戻った時、自分の場の［特徴：式神］を1枚まで選び、アクティブにする。
JJK-3-008.effectEn: When this character returns from your field to your hand, choose up to 1 [Trait: Shikigami] on your field and set it to active.
JJK-3-008.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-008.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-009.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-009.effectJp: このキャラはフロントLにある場合もエナジーを発生させる。【登場時】自分の場の他の［特徴：式神］を1枚手札に戻す。戻せない場合、このキャラを手札に戻す。
JJK-3-009.effectEn: This character also generates energy while in the Front Line. [On Play] Return to the owner's hand 1 other [Trait: Shikigami] on your field. If you can't, return this character to your hand.

JJK-3-010.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-010.effectJp: 【相手のターン中】自分の場に〈夏油 傑〉がある場合、このキャラはBP+1000。
JJK-3-010.effectEn: [During Opponent's Turn] If you have <Suguru Geto> on your field, This character gets BP+1000.
JJK-3-010.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-010.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-011.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-011.effectJp: 自分の山札の上から5枚見る。その中から〈五条 悟〉か〈夏油 傑〉か〈天内 理子〉か〈黒井 美里〉を2枚まで公開し手札に加える。残りを望む順で自分の山札の下に置く。
JJK-3-011.effectEn: Look at the top 5 card(s) of your deck. Reveal up to 2 <Satoru Gojo> or <Suguru Geto> or <Riko Amanai> or <Misato Kuroi> among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

JJK-3-012.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-012.effectJp: 〈術式順転「蒼」〉は1ターンに1枚のみ使用できる。発生エナジーが1以下の相手のエナジーLのキャラを1枚選び、フロントLに移動させる。その後、この移動によって相手のキャラがリムーブエリアに置かれていない場合、カードを1枚引く。（移動させる時にフロントLに空きがない場合、相手はフロントLのカードを1枚選んでリムーブエリアに置いてから移動させる）
JJK-3-012.effectEn: Only 1 <Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue> can be used per 1 turn(s). Choose 1 character in your opponent's Energy Line with generated energy 1 or less, and move it to the Front Line. Then, if none of your opponent's characters were put into the Remove Area by this move, draw 1 card(s). (When moving, if there is no space in the Front Line, your opponent chooses 1 card(s) in their Front Line, puts them into the Remove Area, then moves it)

JJK-3-013.effectJp: 【自分のターン中】【フロントLにある場合】自分の場外に〈宿儺の指〉が1枚以上ある場合、自分の手札にある〈宿儺〉全ての必要エナジーを『【青×1】減らす』。自分の場外に〈宿儺の指〉が4枚以上ある場合、『【青×2】減らす』に代わる。【登場時】カードを1枚引き、自分の手札を1枚場外に置く。
JJK-3-013.effectEn: [During Your Turn] [While in Front Line] If you have 1 or more <宿儺の指> in your Outside Area, reduce the required energy of all <Sukuna> in your hand by [Blue x1]. If you have 4 or more <宿儺の指> in your Outside Area, it becomes “[Blue x2]is reduced” instead. [On Play] Draw 1 card(s), then put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.
JJK-3-013.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-013.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-014.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-014.effectJp: 【インパクト無効】（このキャラとバトルをしたキャラはこのバトル中、【インパクト】を失う）
JJK-3-014.effectEn: [Impact Nullify] (The character that battles this character, during this battle, [Impact] is lost)

JJK-3-015.effectJp: 【レイド】〈虎杖 悠仁〉アクティブにし、フロントLに移動できる【インパクト（1）】（アタックしてバトルに勝利した時、相手プレイヤーに1ダメージ）【登場時】以下から『1つ』選ぶ。自分の場外に〈宿儺の指〉が3枚ある場合、『2つ』に代わる。自分の場外に〈宿儺の指〉が4枚以上ある場合、『全て』に代わる。・自分はカードを1枚引き、相手は自身の手札を1枚場外に置く。・BP2500以上の相手のフロントLのキャラ全ては、このターン中、BP-2000。・BP3500以下の相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚まで選び、退場させる。
JJK-3-015.effectEn: [Raid] Can Raid onto <Yuji Itadori (1-040)>; set it to active and you may move it to the Front Line. [Impact 1] (When this attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to your opponent) [On Play] Choose 1 of the following. If you have 3 <宿儺の指> in your Outside Area, it becomes “2” instead. If you have 4 or more <宿儺の指> in your Outside Area, it becomes “all” instead. You draw 1 card(s), and your opponent puts 1 card(s) from their hand into their Outside Area. All characters in your opponent's Front Line with BP 2500 or more it gets BP-2000 this turn. Choose up to 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP 3500 or less, retire it.
JJK-3-015.triggerJp: 【レイド】このカードを手札に加えるか、必要エナジーを満たしている場合、レイドさせる。
JJK-3-015.triggerEn: [Raid] Add this card to your hand, or if you meet its required energy, Raid it.

JJK-3-016.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-016.effectJp: 【登場時】自分の山札の上から2枚見る。その中から望む枚数を望む順で自分の山札の上に置き、残りを望む順で下に置く。
JJK-3-016.effectEn: [On Play] Look at the top 2 card(s) of your deck. Put any number of them on top of your deck in any order, Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

JJK-3-017.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-017.effectJp: 【登場時】自分の場外から【スペシャルトリガー】と【ファイナルトリガー】をどちらも持たないイベントカードを1枚まで手札に加える。
JJK-3-017.effectEn: [On Play] Add up to 1 Event card(s) that have neither [Special Trigger] nor [Final Trigger] from your Outside Area to your hand.

JJK-3-018.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-018.effectJp: 【相手のターン中】自分の山札が15枚以下の場合、このキャラはBP+1000と【インパクト無効】（このキャラとバトルをしたキャラはこのバトル中、【インパクト】を失う）を得る。【登場時】自分の山札の上から1枚まで場外に置く。
JJK-3-018.effectEn: [During Opponent's Turn] If you have 15 or fewer cards in your deck, this character gets BP+1000 and gains [Impact Nullify] (The character that battles this character loses [Impact] during this battle) [On Play] Put up to the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your Outside Area.

JJK-3-019.effectJp: 【レイド】〈七海 建人〉アクティブにし、フロントLに移動できる【登場時】相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚まで選び、次の自分のターン開始時まで、「このキャラはアタックできない。」を与える。【アタック時】自分の山札の上から1枚まで場外に置く。その後、自分の山札が15枚以下の場合、カードを1枚まで引き、BP1500以上の相手のフロントLのキャラ全ては、このターン中、BP-1000。
JJK-3-019.effectEn: [Raid] Can Raid onto <Kento Nanami (Release Event Participation)>; set it to active and you may move it to the Front Line. [On Play] Choose up to 1 character in your opponent's Front Line, Until the start of your next turn, it gains “This character cannot attack” [When Attacking] Put up to the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your Outside Area. Then, if you have 15 or fewer cards in your deck, draw up to 1 card(s), and all characters in your opponent's Front Line with 1500 or more BP get BP-1000 this turn.
JJK-3-019.triggerJp: 【レイド】このカードを手札に加えるか、必要エナジーを満たしている場合、レイドさせる。
JJK-3-019.triggerEn: [Raid] Add this card to your hand, or if you meet its required energy, Raid it.

JJK-3-020.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards

JJK-3-021.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-021.effectJp: 【退場時】自分の場に〈七海 建人〉がある場合、カードを1枚まで引く。
JJK-3-021.effectEn: [On Retire] If you have <Kento Nanami (Release Event Participation)> on your field, Draw up to 1 card(s).

JJK-3-022.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-022.effectJp: 【起動メイン】【レストにする】【このカードを退場させる】自分の場外から〈七海 建人〉を1枚まで手札に加える。
JJK-3-022.effectEn: [Activate: Main] [Rest this card] [Retire this card] Add up to 1 <Kento Nanami (Release Event Participation)> from your Outside Area to your hand.

JJK-3-023.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-023.effectJp: 【自分のターン中】このターン中に自分の効果で自分の手札か山札のカードが場外に置かれている場合、このキャラはBP+500。
JJK-3-023.effectEn: [During Your Turn] If cards from your hand or deck were put into your Outside Area by your own effect this turn, this character gets BP+500.

JJK-3-024.nameJp: 誇れ オマエは強い
JJK-3-024.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-024.effectJp: 自分のフロントLに〈宿儺〉がある場合、手札にあるこのカードの必要エナジーを【青×2】減らす。元々のBPが4000以上の相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚選び、退場させる。カードを2枚引く。
JJK-3-024.effectEn: If you have <Sukuna> in your Front Line, the required energy of this card in your hand [Blue x2]is reduced. Choose 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with original BP 4000 or more, and retire it. Draw 2 card(s).

JJK-3-025.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-025.effectJp: 【登場時】自分の手札から必要エナジーが2以下で消費APが1の特徴に「呪霊」を持つ紫のキャラカードを1枚まで自分の場にレストで登場させる。
JJK-3-025.effectEn: [On Play] Play up to 1 Purple character card(s) with the trait “Cursed Spirit”, required energy 2 or less and AP cost 1 from your hand to your field rested.

JJK-3-026.effectJp: 自分と相手のライフの合計が4以下の場合、手札にあるこのカードの必要エナジーを【紫×2】減らす。このキャラはアクティブで場に登場させる。【自分のターン中】このキャラはBP+1000。【登場時】このキャラはこのターン中、【インパクト（1）】と【狙い撃ち】（相手のフロントLのキャラを指定してアタックでき、指定した場合、相手はブロックできない）を得る。
JJK-3-026.effectEn: If the total Life of you and your opponent is 4 or less, reduce the required energy of this card in your hand by [Purple x2]. This character is played active. [During Your Turn] This character gets BP+1000. [On Play] This character gains [Impact 1] and [Snipe] (Can attack a character in your opponent's Front Line; if it does, your opponent cannot block) this turn.

JJK-3-027.nameJp: 究極 メカ丸 絶対形態
JJK-3-027.effectJp: 【レイド】〈究極 メカ丸〉アクティブにし、フロントLに移動できる自分の場に他の［特徴：京都校］が5枚以上か〈三輪 霞〉がある場合、このキャラは【インパクト（1）】（アタックしてバトルに勝利した時、相手プレイヤーに1ダメージ）を得る。【登場時】以下から1つ選ぶ。・BP3500以下の相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚まで選び、退場させる。・相手の場のフィールドを1枚まで選び、退場させる。
JJK-3-027.effectEn: [Raid] Can Raid onto <究極 メカ丸>; set it to active and you may move it to the Front Line. If you have 5 or more other [Trait: Kyoto School] or <Kasumi Miwa> on your field, this character gains [Impact 1] (When this character attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to the opposing player) [On Play] Choose 1 of the following. Choose up to 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP 3500 or less, retire it. Choose up to 1 Field on your opponent's field, retire it.
JJK-3-027.triggerJp: 【レイド】このカードを手札に加えるか、必要エナジーを満たしている場合、レイドさせる。
JJK-3-027.triggerEn: [Raid] Add this card to your hand, or if you meet its required energy, Raid it.

JJK-3-028.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-028.effectJp: 【登場時】カードを1枚引き、自分の手札を1枚場外に置く。
JJK-3-028.effectEn: [On Play] Draw 1 card(s), then put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.

JJK-3-029.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-029.effectJp: このカードは〈究極 メカ丸〉としても扱う。
JJK-3-029.effectEn: This card is also treated as <究極 メカ丸>.
JJK-3-029.triggerJp: 【ゲット】このカードを手札に加える。
JJK-3-029.triggerEn: [Get] Add this card to your hand.

JJK-3-030.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-030.effectJp: このカードは〈究極 メカ丸〉としても扱う。【登場時】自分の場に他の［特徴：京都校］が5枚以上か〈三輪 霞〉がある場合、相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚まで選び、このターン中、BP-1000。
JJK-3-030.effectEn: This card is also treated as <究極 メカ丸>. [On Play] If you have 5 or more other [Trait: Kyoto School] or <Kasumi Miwa> on your field, choose up to 1 character in your opponent's Front Line, and it gets BP-1000 this turn.
JJK-3-030.triggerJp: 【カラー】自分の場外から必要エナジーが2以下で消費APが1の紫のキャラカードを1枚自分のフロントLにアクティブで登場させる。
JJK-3-030.triggerEn: [Color] Play 1 Purple character card with required energy 2 or less and with AP cost 1 from your Outside Area to your Front Line active.

JJK-3-031.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-031.effectJp: 【自分のターン中】このターン中にBPが0以下になることか効果によって、キャラが退場している場合、このキャラはBP+1000。
JJK-3-031.effectEn: [During Your Turn] If a character was retired this turn by its BP becoming 0 or less or by an effect, this character gets BP+1000.
JJK-3-031.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-031.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-032.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-032.effectJp: 【退場時】自分の山札の上から2枚を場外に置く。
JJK-3-032.effectEn: [On Retire] Put the top 2 card(s) of your deck into your Outside Area.
JJK-3-032.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-032.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-067.effectEn: [Activate: Main] [While in Front Line] [Once Per Turn] Can only activate if your generated energy is 5 or more. Choose 1 of the following. This character, this turn, [Impact 1](When this attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to your opponent) is gained. You may retire 1 character on your field other than <Mahito>. If you do, Draw 2 card(s), then put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.
JJK-3-067.triggerJp: 【カラー】BP2500以下の相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚選び、退場させる。
JJK-3-067.triggerEn: [Color] Choose 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP 2500 or less, retire it.

JJK-3-068.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-068.effectJp: 【起動メイン】【レストにする】自分の山札の上から1枚を場外に置く。【起動メイン】【レストにする】【このカードを退場させる】自分の場外から〈夏油 傑〉か［特徴：呪霊］か［特徴：呪胎九相図］を1枚自分の山札の上に置く。
JJK-3-068.effectEn: [Activate: Main] [Rest this card] Put the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your Outside Area. [Activate: Main] [Rest this card] [Retire this card] Put 1 <Suguru Geto> or [Trait: Cursed Spirit] or [Trait: Cursed Womb Death Paintings] from your Outside Area on top of your deck.

JJK-3-069.effectJp: 自分の場に〈虎杖 悠仁〉がある場合、手札にあるこのカードの消費APを-1する。BP5000以下の相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚まで選び、退場させる。その後、相手のフロントLにBPが4000以上のキャラが2枚以上ある場合、BP4000以上の自分の場の［特徴：呪術師］を1枚まで選び、このターン中、BP+2000。
JJK-3-069.effectEn: If you have <Yuji Itadori (1-040)> on your field, reduce the AP cost of this card in your hand by 1. Choose up to 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP 5000 or less, retire it. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more characters with 4000 or more BP in their Front Line, choose up to 1 [Trait: Jujutsu Sorcerer] on your field with 4000 or more BP, and it gets BP+2000 this turn.
JJK-3-069.triggerJp: 【スペシャル】相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚選び、退場させる。
JJK-3-069.triggerEn: [Special] Choose 1 character in your opponent's Front Line, retire it.

JJK-3-070.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-070.effectJp: 自分のフロントLに〔［特徴：呪霊］と［特徴：呪胎九相図］が合計2枚以上か〈夏油 傑〉〕がある場合、手札にあるこのカードの消費APを-1する。BP5000以下の相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚選び、リムーブエリアに置く。この効果でBPが5000のキャラをリムーブエリアに置いた場合、カードを1枚まで引く。
JJK-3-070.effectEn: If you have 2 or more [Trait: Cursed Spirit] and [Trait: Cursed Womb Death Paintings] in total or <Suguru Geto> in your Front Line, reduce the AP cost of this card in your hand by 1. Choose 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP 5000 or less, and put it into the Remove Area. If you put a character with BP 5000 into the Remove Area by this effect, draw up to 1 card(s).
JJK-3-070.triggerJp: 【スペシャル】相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚選び、退場させる。
JJK-3-070.triggerEn: [Special] Choose 1 character in your opponent's Front Line, retire it.

JJK-3-071.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-071.effectJp: 自分のフロントLの〈脹相〉、〈壊相〉、〈血塗〉、〈虎杖 悠仁〉をそれぞれ1枚まで選び、このターン中、BP+1000。〈脹相〉を含め合計2枚以上選んだ場合、この効果で選んだ〈脹相〉に、さらにこのターン中、【インパクト（+1）】（インパクトの与えるダメージが+1され、インパクトを持たない場合、【インパクト（1）】を得る）を与える。〈脹相〉を含め合計3枚以上選んだ場合、カードを1枚引く。
JJK-3-071.effectEn: Choose up to 1 each of <Choso>, <Eso>, <Kechizu> and <Yuji Itadori (1-040)> in your Front Line, and they get BP+1000 this turn. If you chose 2 or more in total including <Choso>, <Choso> chosen by this effect also gains [Impact +1] (Damage dealt by Impact is increased by 1; if it doesn't have Impact, it gains [Impact 1]) this turn. If you chose 3 or more in total including <Choso>, draw 1 card(s).
JJK-3-071.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
JJK-3-071.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

JJK-3-072.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-072.effectJp: ※このカードはデッキに3枚までしか入れられない。自分のリムーブエリアに〈五条 悟〉がある場合、手札にあるこのカードの必要エナジーを【赤×3】減らす。カードを1枚引く。自分の手札から必要エナジーが3以下で消費APが1の赤の［特徴：呪術師］を2枚まで自分の場にレストで登場させる。
JJK-3-072.effectEn: ※You can only include up to 3 copies of this card in your deck. If you have <Satoru Gojo> in your Remove Area, reduce the required energy of this card in your hand by [Red x3]. Draw 1 card(s). Play up to 2 Red [Trait: Jujutsu Sorcerer] with required energy 3 or less and with AP cost 1 from your hand to your field rested.

JJK-3-073.setName: UEX02BT: Jujutsu Kaisen Vol.2 Release Event Cards
JJK-3-073.effectJp: 自分のAPカードを2枚まで選び、アクティブにする。
JJK-3-073.effectEn: Choose up to 2 of your AP cards, set it to active.
JJK-3-073.triggerJp: 【ファイナル】自分のライフが無い場合、自分の山札の上から1枚を自分のライフエリアに置く。
JJK-3-073.triggerEn: [Final] If you have no Life, put the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your Life Area.
